name: El Lloar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over light blue, charged towards the hoist with a red flaming sword with a light blue hilt, point upward.
history: The official flag of El Lloar is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, a horizontal bicolour of yellow and light blue, with the red flaming sword with light blue hilt of the arms, point upward, of height 2/5 of the cloth; the council agreed on 26 January 2008 to submit the proposal, published in the DOGC on 20 August 2008, and it was finally approved on 26 July 2010.

features.role: flaming sword with its point upward on the yellow
